storage.wipe.longRunning: This can take a while — from a few minutes up to several hours, depending on how big the drive is.
storage.wipe.destructiveHint: Your files stay safe. This only clears what you've already deleted so it can't be recovered later.
undo.irreversible: Once done, this can't be undone.
dryrun.storage.wipe: This will clear deleted files from drive {drive} so they can no longer be recovered.
